title: Louis Rossmann dismantles Apple's PR stunt "repair program"
summary: Louis Rossmann criticizes Apple's independent repair provider program as a PR move with invasive contract terms. He argues it does little for independent shops or customers.
why: Cited in right-to-repair threads as a repair-shop view of why Apple's program is impractical.

quote.text: AFAIK Louis Rossmann has criticized Apple for creating a really unpractical program
